description: Layered PNG assets and Codex handoff for a simple XP gain overlay shown after a loss or end-of-hand result.
dynamicContent: placement text such as '4TH PLACE' or '2ND'
xp gain text such as '+24 XP'
level badge or star count if desired

assets.role: animated fill layer inside the XP bar; crop or mask width in Rive
left circular star medallion for the XP bar
blank popup plaque used for '+XP' amount
large subtle background burst behind XP UI
foreground sparkle/star burst when XP pops in or bar completes
soft glow behind the bar or popup
optional pulse glow over the bar
